stem:
Meera wants to separate mixtures at home using a sieve. Sieving works when the particles of one part are small enough to pass through the holes while the bigger particles stay on the sieve.

For which mixture will sieving NOT work?

teacher.key_rationale: Sieving separates solid particles by size. In A, B and D the components differ in particle size, so a suitable sieve retains the larger particles while the smaller pass through. In C the salt is dissolved in water and forms no separate solid particles, so it passes through with the water and sieving cannot separate it. Key: C.
